capabilities: Import .ds-hero files into a formatted hero note
Import filled MCDM character-sheet PDFs into a hero note
Resolve Power Rolls and tier damage to the hero's actual values
Set frontmatter properties for each hero
Archive the previous version of a note on re-import
extras: Not available in the community plugin store yet; installed via BRAT (zachhall/drawsteel-hero-importer) or manually from releases. Full documentation lives in a separate DOCUMENTATION.md, and PDF import has its own FILLABLE PDF BEST PRACTICES.md; PDF import only works against MCDM's Standard character sheet and needs a DS Compendium vault folder to fill gaps.
problem: Draw Steel players have no built-in way to bring their character data from ForgeSteel or the official PDF sheet into an Obsidian note without rebuilding it by hand.

relations.evidence: required. The generated Note only renders correctly with this plugin installed and enabled
Optional: Power Roll Detector — makes the Note's Power Roll + N values clickable dice rollers.

summary: Imports a ForgeSteel .ds-hero export or a filled MCDM character-sheet PDF into a single note formatted with Draw Steel Elements codeblocks.
